text:
zara: FYI console shows a burst of rejects for tool="notification_dispatch" on route="exp-v2". Top reasons: "parse_error" and "unexpected_type". Mostly the model is returning a JSON string instead of an object.

tom: Any sample payload?

zara: Copied a single line from logs:
`{req: "r-77", tool: "notification_dispatch", error: "unexpected_type", expected: object(fields: [title, body]), actual: "{\"title\":\"hi\",\"body\":\"yo\"}"}`

anika: So the model serialised the object into a string to save tokens. We had a compacting pass on that tag. It shouldn't have reached exp-v2 though.

zara: Query I ran: `select count(*) from invokes where tool='notification_dispatch' and reject=true and route='exp-v2' and ts > now() - interval '3 hours'` -> ~240 rejects, big enough to trigger support pages.

tom: Does this increment billing or SLA alerts? Billing team alerted on an error spike.

billing-bot: Alert: derived 502 pages for acct=marketplace-consumers from invokes.rejects burst

anika: We need better telemetry: add fields `validation_reason`, `validation_action` (blocked|coerced), `coercion_detail` (e.g., parse_json_string), and `route_origin`. Mark coerced events with `soft_reject=true`. Sample full payloads at 1% with redaction.

zara: Short-term mitigation idea: adapter attempts a single parse if actual looks like a JSON string; set `coercion=parse_json_string` in trace and return success to caller. Roll this to exp-v2 only.

tom: Risk: masking a real model regression. Set a TTL for shim (4 hours) and log both `original_raw` and `parsed_payload` to S3 for audit. Also add an alert if coercion rate > 0.1% for 15m.

anika: Agreed. Console UX: add a filter for `validation_action=coerced` and show a small note: "coercion applied - parsed JSON string into object (check raw)" with link to raw logs. Also show example diff between expected schema and parsed result.

ops-bot: deploy started: adapter-parse-shim-v1 -> exp-v2 (initiated by zara)

zara: I'll push the shim PR and run unit tests. If green, deploy to exp-v2.

tom: I'll patch telemetry to emit `validation_reason` and sample payloads, and add the histogram metric `rejects_by_route`.

anika: We should also add a lightweight preflight to the model rollout pipeline: run 50 canonical prompts and assert `is_object(output)` for any tool-bound model. Fail the rollout if sample failure rate > 0.5%.

zara: PR submitted: github.com/redwood/adapter/pull/999 - tests passing locally. Deploying canary now.

ops-bot: deploy finished: adapter-parse-shim-v1 -> exp-v2 :truck:

zara: Seeing immediate drop in pages. Will monitor for 2 hours, then decide whether to rollback the model tag. If coercion persists, we'll revert.

anika: Telemetry changes merged. Sampling at 1%, redaction enabled. Added alert for coercion rate threshold.

tom: Console filter added for `validation_action` + redacted sample viewer and "how to fix" link.

zara: Filing short follow-up note for model team to prevent future compacting passes on tool-bound outputs.
